rationale: Imran Khan and PTI filed petitions (Feb, May 11, May 19, and June 18, 2026 chamber appeal) before Pakistan Supreme Court specifically requesting transfer from Adiala Jail to Shifa International Hospital for right-eye CRVO care. Government transfers thus far used Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS), while SC medical board retina specialist Prof. Nadeem Qureshi is from Al-Shifa Trust Eye Hospital in Rawalpindi -> sum=0.92.
